articles.summary: HOUSTON, April 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. (Nasdaq: PAA) and Plains GP Holdings (Nasdaq: PAGP) announced today their quarterly distributions with respect to the first quarter of 2026 and also announced timing of first quarter 2026 earnings.
articles.title: Plains All American Pipeline and Plains GP Holdings Announce Quarterly Distributions and Timing of First Quarter 2026 Earnings
